data_role: 12 independent publicly annotated Talk2Car-RegSeg source scenes, evaluation purposes only, excluded by name from known prior project cohorts; foundation-model exposure unknown.
pairing: Each model receives exactly one identical first request per source and is allowed one follow-up per first native semantic response. Direct reuses that actual turn0 analytically. Both conditions receive the same prewritten full original on turn1; their previous assistant content may differ because it is the real response for that model.

followup.when: every successful semantic turn0, including proposed, clarification, insufficient visual evidence; irrespective of target or point correctness
followup.dialogue: previous user concise text; verbatim prior native receipt.raw_text as assistant, both explicitly bound to same original frame; no synthetic confirmation, rejection or extra hints
followup.otherwise: no second call on operational/malformed first response, retain case as ineligible first-stage error and score zero in follow-up; second error retained as zero without fallback

metrics.mask_hit: all 12 per arm; native mask pixel mapped from original coordinates after floor; proposed points only, missing/error=0
metrics.box_metric: arithmetic mean predicted rectangle IoU vs tight nonzero native mask bounding rectangle scaled to original resolution, all 12 with missing/error=0; not predicted-mask IoU
metrics.paired: paired wins/losses/ties by source across arms, exact two-sided McNemar for hits; interpretation descriptive given n=12
metrics.cost: native calls, eligible/completed followups, status/error counts, measured per native call elapsed time; direct first call shared, two-turn cost explicitly sums both
metrics.region_reference: original public navigable-region mask, nonzero native grayscale pixels, no resampling
metrics.missing_reference: retain all source IDs and alarms; report available-reference sensitivity separately if a mask is empty/malformed; no replacements

ordinary_runner: tools.dropoff_predict.predict with GroundingModel subclass that only journals the returned real receipt and performs no substitution. Four native output folders. Fresh stage invokes separate Python process for actual GPU worker loading.
recovery: A completed seal is immutable. An unexpected interrupted outer runner is preserved; resume only the exact inputs with an explicit audited per-call journal, never silently replace a recorded model decision.
